svg.aria-label: Seven scenes: a patient enters a PET/CT scanner; the scan detects photons; data fills a sinogram; a neural network corrects the data; reconstruction produces an image; a CNN sharpens it; the lesion is found and its uptake measured.
svg.title: From patient to insight
svg.text: A patient with small lesions enters the PET/CT scanner.
The CT tube rotates around the body; PET detects pairs of photons.
Every detection lands in a sinogram: the raw data, noisy and blurred.
A neural network corrects the measured data before reconstruction.
Reconstruction turns data into an image, still blurred by the physics.
A CNN removes the blur and noise: a sharp, faithful image.
The physicist gets answers: where the lesion is and how much it takes up.
